title: tanarius angolensis
intro: Tanarius angolensis, commonly known as Devil's Claw, is a plant species that belongs to the sesame family and is native to southern Africa. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including the alleviation of pain, inflammation, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Tanarius angolensis include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as harpagoside, which has been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Tanarius angolensis have also been found to include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic properties.
